name: Visual Crowd Optical Flow Benchmark
description: A vision benchmark for optical flow estimation on synthetic crowd scenes with ground-truth flow, designed to stress real-world surveillance-style motion with many small, partially independent, non-rigid moving people rather than large displacement motion.
evaluation_method: End-point error (EPE) and related optical flow error measures comparing predicted dense flow fields to ground truth.
notes: Focused on crowd behavior analysis scenarios; benchmark data are generated via a video engine with synthetic ground-truth flow. Exact sample count is not provided in the metadata.
